change_title: Purchase Requisition creation moves to Fiori app
description: Creating a Purchase Requisition moves from SAP GUI transaction ME51N to the Fiori app 'Create Purchase Requisition - Advanced'. Approval routing and mandatory fields are unchanged; only the entry screen and navigation change.

audience.primary: Procurement Requesters (approx. 340 staff across all business units)

key_messages: What changes: screen and navigation only, not the approval process
When: go-live 16 Nov 2026, ME51N access removed same day
What to do: complete the 15-min e-learning before go-live; a job aid is available
Who to contact: Procurement Shared Services helpdesk
